answer: New agents enter only through a sponsor who stakes a jade bond of 40 POA per newcomer, so a canyon of fake identities needs a sponsor for every one. The bond decays: each epoch of honest work returns 2 POA, while idle identities lose the bond and their sponsor is slashed too. A comet of 100 fake sign-ups costs the sponsor 4,000 POA, no refund. One honest agent costs a 40 POA bond that comes back, so joining stays cheap and rewards undiluted.
